newsitem.title: USA: U.S. GULF JET DIFFS STAY FIRM AS BUYERS STEP UP.
newsitem.headline: U.S. GULF JET DIFFS STAY FIRM AS BUYERS STEP UP.

text.p: U.S. Gulf jet fuel attracted solid buying interest Tuesday, keeping differentials at relatively firm levels.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil gained 0.74 cent to settle at 55.10 cents a gallon.
Prompt U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel changed hands as high as 0.70 cent over the September futures as buyers met sellers' prices, one trader said.
"The quality seems to be on the buy side," according to one player.

"We keep waiting for jet fuel to fall off, from barrels not used because of the UPS strike or the supply situation, but its just keeps hanging on," he added, referring to the estimated 30,000 barrels a day used by the delivery company and the ample supplies seen in the Gulf.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
